{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check balance of key covariates by arm
# Cross-tabulate arm with severity, sex, and site

# Severity by arm
df.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Sex by arm
df.groupby(['arm', 'sex']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Site by arm
df.groupby(['arm', 'site']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)"}
